verses.en: And after Abimelech there arose to defend Israel Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar; and he dwelt in Shamir in mount Ephraim.
verses.sm: O le faamasino a Tulaga ma Iairo Apimeleko ona tu mai ai lea e faaola ia Isaraelu o Tulaga le atalii o Pua, le atalii lea o Toto, o le tagata o Isakara, sa mau o ia i Samira i le mauga o Efaraima.

verses.en: And he judged Israel twenty and three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.
verses.sm: Na ia faamasino ia Isaraelu i tausaga e luafulu ma le tolu, ona oti ai lea o ia, ua tanumia i Samira.

verses.en: And after him arose Jair, a Gileadite, and judged Israel twenty and two years.
verses.sm: Ua mavae o ia ona tu mai ai lea o lairo le Kiliata; na ia faamasino ia Isaraelu i tausaga e luafulu ma le lua.

verses.en: And he had thirty sons that rode on thirty ass colts, and they had thirty cities, which are called Havoth-jair unto this day, which are in the land of Gilead.
verses.sm: Sa la te ia atalii e toatolugafulu, e na tietie i asini e tolu sefulu; sa ia i latou o aai e tolu sefulu, ua igoa ai o Havota-iairo ua oo mai i le aso nei, o loo i le nuu o Kiliata.

verses.en: And Jair died, and was buried in Camon.
verses.sm: Ua oti Iairo, ua tanumia i Kamoni.

verses.en: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD, and served Baalim, and Ashtaroth, and the gods of Syria, and the gods of Zidon, and the gods of Moab, and the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines, and forsook the LORD, and served not him.
verses.sm: Ona toe amio leaga lea o le fanauga a Isaraelu i luma o le Au, ua latou auauna ia Paala, ma Asaira, ma atua o Suria, ma atua o Saitonu, ma atua o Moapi, ma atua o le fanauga a Amoni, ma atua o Filisitia; a ua latou tuulafoai i le ALII, ua latou le auauna ia te ia.

verses.en: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he sold them into the hands of the Philistines, and into the hands of the children of Ammon.
verses.sm: Ona toasa tele ai lea o le ALII ia Isaraelu, ua na tuuina atu ai i latou i lima o Filisitia, ma lima o le fanauga a Amoni.

verses.en: And that year they vexed and oppressed the children of Israel: eighteen years, all the children of Israel that were on the other side Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which is in Gilead.
verses.sm: Sa latou faatiga, ma faasaua i le fanauga a Isaraelu i ja ona po i tausaga e sefulu ma le valu, o le fanauga uma a Isaraelu e na i le la itu o Ioritana i le nuu o sa Amori i Kiliata.

verses.en: Moreover the children of Ammon passed over Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim; so that Israel was sore distressed.
verses.sm: Ona sopoia atu lea o le fanauga a Amoni i Ioritana, latou te tau ma Iuta, ma Peniamina, ma le aiga o Efaraima; ua matuā puapuagaina Isaraelu.

verses.en: And the children of Israel cried unto the LORD, saying, We have sinned against thee, both because we have forsaken our God, and also served Baalim.
verses.sm: Ona alalaga lea o le fanauga a Isaraelu i le ALII, o loo faapea, Ua matou agasala atu ia te oe, ina ua matou tuulafoai i lo matou Atua, a ua matou auauna ia Paala.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto the children of Israel, Did not I deliver you from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?
verses.sm: Ona fetalai mai lea o le ALII i le fanauga a Isaraelu, E le o Aikupito ea, ma sa Amori, ma le fanauga a Amoni, ma Filisitia;

verses.en: The Zidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, did oppress you; and ye cried to me, and I delivered you out of their hand.
verses.sm: ma sa Saitonu, ma Amaleka, ma Meona, sa latou faasauaina outou, ona ou~ tou valaau mai lea ia te au, ma ou faaolaina outou ai o latou lima.

verses.en: Yet ye have forsaken me, and served other gods: wherefore I will deliver you no more.
verses.sm: A o outou, ua outou tuulafoaiina aʻu, ma ua outou auauna i atua ese; o le mea lea ou te le toe faaola ai ia te outou.

verses.en: Go and cry unto the gods which ye have chosen; let them deliver you in the time of your tribulation.
verses.sm: O ia, ina valaau i atua ua outou loto i ai, seʻi latou faaola ia te outou i ona po o lo outou puapuaga.

verses.en: And the children of Israel said unto the LORD, We have sinned: do thou unto us whatsoever seemeth good unto thee; deliver us only, we pray thee, this day.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o le fanauga a Isaraelu i le Aw, Ua matou agasala, ia e faia ia te i matou mea uma ua e finagalo i ai; tau lava ina e laveai mai ia te i matou i lenei aso.

verses.en: And they put away the strange gods from among them, and served the LORD: and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.
verses.sm: Ona latou tuu ese lea O atua ese sa ja te i latou, ma latou auauna i le ALII; na tigaina lona finagalo ona o le puapuaga o Isaraelu.

verses.en: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together, and encamped in Gilead. And the children of Israel assembled themselves together, and encamped in Mizpeh.
verses.sm: Ua faapotopotoina le fanauga a Amoni, ma latou to lauapi i Kiliata; ona faapotopoto lea o le fanauga a Isaraelu, ua to lauapi i latou i Mesepa.

verses.en: And the people and princes of Gilead said one to another, What man is he that will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? he shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.
verses.sm: Ona fai ane lea o le nuu ma alii o Kiliata o le tasi i le tasi, O ai se tasi na te amata ona tau ma le fanauga a Amoni? e fai o ia ma alii sili i e nonofo uma lava i Kiliata. O le tala ia
